{'text': "Apple previously shelved the long-rumoured all-glass iPhone, which was originally planned as a commemorative device for the 20th anniversary of the iPhone's launch. However, according to the latest report from Bloomberg, the design overhaul is still on track and will be applied to the Pro models next year. Details below.", 'source': 'Earlier reports indicated that Apple had shelved the long-rumoured all-glass iPhone, a device originally intended to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the iPhone. However, according to a Bloomberg report, the design overhaul is still on track and will launch on the Pro models next year. Details below.'}

{'text': 'Bloomberg says the design overhaul is on schedule', 'source': 'Bloomberg says the design overhaul is on schedule'}

{'text': "Investment research firm Jefferies downgraded Apple stock this morning, citing supply chain findings that Apple has abandoned plans for an all-glass iPhone originally intended to celebrate the iPhone's 20th anniversary.", 'source': "This morning, investment research firm Jefferies downgraded Apple stock, citing its supply chain findings that Apple has abandoned plans for an all-glass iPhone originally intended to celebrate the iPhone's 20th anniversary."}

{'text': 'However, a more recent Bloomberg report notes that Apple "is expected to launch an iPhone Pro model next year featuring an all-new glass design," adding that "the front and back of the device will use glass — internal code names V73 and V74 — with the material extending to both sides and a metal frame running through the middle."', 'source': 'However, a more recent Bloomberg report notes that the company "is expected to launch an iPhone Pro model next year featuring an all-new glass design," adding that "the front and back of the device will use glass — internal code names V73 and V74 — with the material extending to both sides and a metal frame running through the middle."'}

{'text': 'However, the report also noted that the project has been adjusted since its original conception:', 'source': 'However, the report also noted that the project has been adjusted since its original conception:'}

{'text': 'The report directly refutes Jefferies\' earlier note, adding that "there is no change to Apple\'s product roadmap."', 'source': 'The report directly refutes Jefferies\' earlier note, adding that "there is no change to Apple\'s product roadmap."'}

{'text': 'The Jefferies take', 'source': 'The Jefferies take'}

{'text': "Jefferies analyst Edison Lee said this morning that, based on the firm's supply chain checks, the all-glass iPhone has been cancelled due to poor production yield rates.", 'source': "Jefferies analyst Edison Lee said this morning that, based on the firm's supply chain checks, the all-glass iPhone has been cancelled due to poor production yield rates."}

{'text': 'Lee described the development as a "significant setback" for Apple, and noted that, against the backdrop of rising memory costs, the cancellation could affect Apple\'s ability to push up prices and boost the average selling price and margins of its Pro models.', 'source': 'Lee described the development as a "significant setback" for Apple, and noted that, against the backdrop of rising memory costs, the cancellation could affect Apple\'s ability to push up prices and boost the average selling price and margins of its Pro models.'}

{'text': 'As a result, Jefferies downgraded Apple stock and cut its price target from US$285.56 to US$263.66. The previous price target cut was on 31 July, when it was lowered from US$308.92 after Apple reported its fiscal third-quarter 2026 results and issued cautious guidance for the fourth quarter.', 'source': 'As a result, Jefferies downgraded Apple stock and cut its price target from US$285.56 to US$263.66. The previous price target cut was on 31 July, when it was lowered from US$308.92 after Apple reported its fiscal third-quarter 2026 results and issued cautious guidance for the fourth quarter.'}
